We are dropping the column 'ITEM_LEADING_ZERO_ID' and keeping only ITEM_ID and renamed as 'SALES_ORDER_ITEM_ID' in Result.
To pull Proc_Item_Id from PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_BRD_ITEM_MAPPING_CORE_PIT with co_product_ind = 'Y' , join it with PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_DMD_SALES_ORDER_SHIPMENT_DETAIL_ROOT on Item_Id column and pull Proc_Item_Id if available. If Proc_Item_Id is null or Blank then keep Item_Id from V_DMD_SALES_ORDER_SHIPMENT_DETAIL_ROOT and renamed as 'Derived ITEM_ID'.
In final result  'Derived ITEM_ID' will renamed as 'ITEM_ID'.
For Sum of shipment qty , we will take sum of 'GROSS_ACTUAL_GOODS_ISSUE_SHIPMENT_QTY' and group by on SALES_ORDER_ID, SALES_ORDER_LINE_NBR, SALES_ORDER_SCHEDULE_LINE_NBR, DERIVED_ITEM_ID, PLANT_CD, ACTUAL_GOODS_MOVEMENT_DTM.

blocks.text:
1.) Add a new column DELRDD_CALC_DT
Logic for DELRDD_CALC_DT:
.Join the PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_DMD_SALES_ORDER_TRANSACTIONAL_DETAIL_ROOT with PDH_COMMON_XFRM_BASE.T_DMD_SALES_ORDER_TRANSACTIONAL_DETAIL_CORE_CURRENT on SALES_ORDER_ID, SALES_ORDER_LINE_NBR and SALES_ORDER_SCHEDULE_LINE_NBR. 
If a matching record is found in T_DMD_SALES_ORDER_TRANSACTIONAL_DETAIL_CORE_CURRENT and the column DELRDD_CAL_DT is not null, then:
  Set DELRDD_CALC_DT in V_DMD_SALES_ORDER_TRANSACTIONAL_DETAIL_STAGE = value of DELRDD_CAL_DT from T_DMD_SALES_ORDER_TRANSACTIONAL_DETAIL_CORE_CURRENT.
If DELRDD_CAL_DT is null, then apply the following logic:
 check if Requested_Goods_Issue_DT < PLan_Start_date (i.e., Saturday of the last week + Order Lead Time + 7 days) and Confirmed_Goods_issue_DT is Null 
   then  DELRDD_CALC_DT  =  PLan_Start_date (i.e., Saturday of the last week + Customer Order Lead Time + 7 days).

2.) Fetch order Lead time (PARAMETER_QTY) for Current Workweek by joining ON ITEM_ID from PDH_COMMON_XFRM.V_DMD_SALES_ORDER_TRANSACTIONAL_DETAIL_ROOT and PDH_COMMON_ANALYSIS.V_PRM_ITEM_LOC_CORE_PIT
where PARAMETER_NM = 'ORDER_LEAD_TIME'


3.) Add a new column CO_PROD_IND
Logic for CO_PROD_IND:

if SALES_ORDER_LINE_CATEGORY_CD = 'ZCOP' then CO_PROD_IND = 'Y' 
else  CO_PROD_IND = 'N'
3.) Add a new column CO_PROD_IND
Logic for CO_PROD_IND:

 if SALES_ORDER_LINE_CATEGORY_CD <> (SELECT column_value_two_text FROM if_supply_chain.pdh_common_analysis.t_crr_business_rule_metadata_detail_core_pit
                                                                        WHERE subject_area_nm  = 'SalesOrder' ,
                                                                                      entitty_nm = 'SalesOrderTransaction',
                                                                                      business_rule_nm = 'SalesOrder_CategoryCd_Config',
                                                                                      column_value_one_text = 'Exclude' )

      CO_PROD_IND = 'Y'
else 
      CO_PROD_IND = 'N'
